Hi Camilo,

You can either export the the raster and shapefile ( ?export ) and plot them by whatever methods can plot those, or in the development version of the package you can include a background raster or shapefile to plot atop of ( ?plot.telemetry ), but I think they need to be put into in the same projection. There are also some map-specific functions for this in the ctmmweb package.

Best,
Chris
